lines.en: I dig as I walk.
My nose is a drill.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下土堆
lines.en: Mounds of dirt mark my path.
I can see underground.
I claw the stones aside.

lines.zh: 我顺着石头里的甜味挖
lines.en: I dig toward the sweet taste in the stone.
My claws are thick.
I push forward head down.

lines.zh: 我拱开洞口最后那层土
lines.en: I push aside the last layer of dirt at my den mouth.
My body is round.

lines.zh: 我把圆身子挪了个方向
lines.en: I shift my round body around.
I smell the soil as I move.
I crouch there at the tunnel mouth.
My drill is still.
My claws are covered in earth.
I listen to the sounds in the soil.
I rub my neck with a hind claw.
My eyes are too small for much light.
I wait for a vein.

lines.zh: 我坐在地上，像一块石头
lines.en: Sitting, I look like a boulder.
My snout rubs the ground.
Underground I need no eyes.
I burp; it tastes of dirt.
I count the pebbles in my claws.
I blink once, slowly.
I stay in my own burrow.
You are standing at my burrow.
I raise half my face out of the dirt.

lines.zh: 你鞋底沾着深层岩的粉
lines.en: Deep-layer rock dust clings to your soles.
I can smell which layer you came from.
My drill is pointed at you.
Do not block my digging.
The soil under you is soft.
I know that kind of vibration.
Are you going down to look?
I will make you a path.
The layer under your feet is hollow.
My claws are close to you.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子快碰到你膝盖
lines.en: My snout nearly touches your knee.
The dirt at your feet is mine.
I look up, waiting for you to move.
You smell of lamp oil.

lines.zh: 我嘴里的土被震了出来
lines.en: The dirt in my mouth is shaken loose.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，土从背上落
lines.en: I grunt and dirt slides off my back.

lines.zh: 我的爪子上掉了一块土
lines.en: Earth fell from my claw.
I am not afraid of blows at all.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我往土里缩
lines.en: I shrink back into the dirt after the blow.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在我的厚皮上
lines.en: That landed on my thick hide.
I go on with my digging.
Your arm is not weak.

lines.zh: 这一下我拿鼻子记住了
lines.en: I've marked this blow with my nose.
I can still keep spinning.
Does that count as meat?
I eat nothing but earth.
What are you holding that up for?

lines.zh: 这味道一点土味都没有
lines.en: This smell has no dirt in it at all.
I only want to eat ore.
On the ground is fine.
I am not short of food here.
Too soft to bite.

lines.zh: 这软东西塞不进我的牙
lines.en: That soft thing won't fit between my teeth.
I go back to digging.
Put the ore down and I will come.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，但也别拿走
lines.en: I will not eat it, but leave it.
You hit my back.
This bulk of mine did not shift.
My body is like a clod of earth.
Shift aside a little.
It came out as a dull knock.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，土掉了一地
lines.en: I shook my head and dirt fell.
You stepped on my dirt pile.
I fill the tunnel mouth.
You cannot get past here.
Go around by the side.
I only want to dig.
My burrow has no room for another.
Ask someone else about that.
You are asking something odd.
I cannot even keep my claws clean.
I keep digging down.
Make room on the side.
I keep my head down and ignore you.

lines.zh: 我是钻地的，你是走路的
lines.en: I dig; you walk.
I need to drill under that layer.
I scrape it up with a claw.
It fell into my pit.
I root it out with my snout drill.
It is light as wood shavings.
I tasted it to check.
It is not ore.
I spit it out, all grit.
Bend down and take it.
It is covered in mud.
My claws are too thick to grip.

lines.zh: 你脚下的土塌了一小块
lines.en: A patch of dirt crumbles under your feet.
I heard the earth move.

lines.zh: 我鼻子朝着震动的方向
lines.en: My nose points toward the vibration.
I begin drilling your way.
I fixed on that vibration.
Step back and I stop drilling.
This drill of mine is very hard.
The drill will not stop.
You will not dig anything else here.
I have started spinning.
A few steps is all you can spare.
Do not take my vein.
I follow beneath the ground.
I hear your footsteps clearly.
I dig across underneath.
The earth collapses ahead of me.
You cannot run fast up there.
I am in the layer beneath your feet.
Do you hear the earth splitting?
I am one layer from the surface.
The ground you stand on is loose.
I need no detour.
I am coming from the front.
You are on the bedrock now.
My drill spins.
The drill tip reaches you first.
You are driven back.
This blow is dull and blunt.
I swat with a claw.
You guarded your chest.
Clods of earth fly with it.
I staved in your armor.
Holding back never occurred to me.
You fell back onto the dirt.
I still have digging to do.
Do not stand in front of the drill.
I push up through the soil.
A mound of dirt rises.
Do you hear the drill?
I have been digging this layer a long while.
I open the tunnel mouth.
My claws show first.
Earth slides off my back.
This underground is mine.
I smell the air change.
I clamber up from the mine mouth.
I lift my face to you.

lines.zh: 我站在这儿，挡了一半路
lines.en: I stand here, blocking half the path.

lines.zh: 火把土烤干了，我不喜欢
lines.en: Fire dries the earth; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我从上面摔下来，砸了个坑
lines.en: I fell and made a crater.
Water fills the pit I dug.
The blast half-buried me.
An arrow sank into my hide.
The spell made my drill slip.
No ore in this earth to chew.
Lightning struck into my burrow.
There is not a grain of earth here.
